name: com.labeledrecorder
description: Writes a machine-readable label track (events, spans, game-data changes, markers) alongside every Unity Recorder capture. Labels are emitted from game code with one-line calls that compile away completely in player builds. Intended to give AI agents the timecode context they need to cut shorts and trailers automatically.

samples.description: A single MonoBehaviour showing every label call: events, spans, signals, highlights and chapters.
